message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. The facts: defendant set fire to grass while doing farm work, causing fire that burned mango seedlings. No approval from forestry authority. Area burned: 9.6 hectares (144.5 mu) of non-forest land, seedlings destroyed valued 75,279 yuan. This is similar to "失火" (arson) but need to see classification: In Chinese law, "放火罪" (arson) applies to causing fire that destroys forest, farmland, etc. There's also "非法占用林地" etc. But the examples: earlier similar case with burning forest area 99.1 mu was labeled "失火". Another case with greenhouse fire due to welding was also "失火". So they use "失火" as the charge label for causing fire (maybe "放火罪" but they label as "失火").

Thus answer likely "失火". No other charges like "非法占用林地" because no mention of illegal use. The act of setting fire without permission may be "非法采伐林木罪"? No. So just "失火". Provide JSON with reasoning and final answer.
